overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs DCT Oval Barrel Tub 50-P 3/4 IN-OUT Without Motor is a premium inflatable cold therapy tub designed for effective muscle relaxation and stress relief. With a 50-gallon capacity and a durable drop stitch PVC structure, this tub offers a spacious and ergonomic design, making it ideal for home wellness spaces like basements or fitness rooms. Its reduced height ensures safe entry and exit, complemented by child safety latches for added security. Enhance your recovery routine with optional chiller units and enjoy the convenience of included accessories like an anti-slip mat and a premium carry bag, all backed by a 1-year warranty.
